title: Holistic Review Rating Explorer
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Compare applicant files with similar grades and see how a first reader's separate Academic, Activities, and Personal ratings respond to each part of the file, and to context.

learningObjectives: Students will compare applicant files with similar academic numbers and attribute differences in reader ratings to specific parts of each file.

controls: Applicant A, Applicant B, and Dana buttons
Reader has the school profile checkbox

keyQuestions: Why don't readers add the three ratings into one score?
Which parts of an application can you still change in senior year?
What does the school profile tell a reader that the transcript can't?
commonMisconceptions: Identical GPAs and test scores guarantee the same outcome.
More activities always earn a better activities rating than fewer, deeper ones.
assessmentOpportunities: Students attribute a difference in reader ratings between two files to a specific part of the application and explain the role of context.
